title: Alan Bennett - Five to Eleven
description: Alan Bennett reads an extract from Bleak House by Charles Dickens.

description: Seamus Heaney travels across Lough Erne in Fermanagh.

title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
description: Michael Palin reaches Australia, where his activities include a cameo role in Home and Away. He also looks for sperm whales in New Zealand's icy waters.

title: Miss Marple: The Moving Finger
description: Miss Marple's instinct - that one murder will always follow another - proves to be true when more bodies are found in the sleepy town.

title: Talking Pictures: Catherine Deneuve
description: Celia Imrie tells the story of the Ice Queen of French cinema, Catherine Deneuve.

title: Belle de Jour
description: A bored young housewife decides to spend her midweek afternoons working at a high-class brothel. Louis Bunuel's erotic masterpiece. Contains scenes of a sexual nature.

title: On the Set of Belle de Jour - Release
description: Veteran film-maker Luis Buñuel shown at work on his 1967 film Belle de Jour. Deals with adult themes.

title: Kirsty Wark Talks to Catherine Deneuve
description: Kirsty Wark interviews renowned French actress Catherine Deneuve about her life and career.

title: The Life and Times of Don Luis Buñuel - Arena
description: Illuminating portrait of one of the great masters of cinema, Luis Buñuel. Deals with adult themes.

title: To the Manor Born
description: Sitcom about a lady of the manor who is forced to give up her home to a grocery tycoon. A rare bird nesting on the estate attracts interest among local naturalists.

title: Keeping Up Appearances
description: Sitcom. When Bruce and Violet's constant arguing threatens Hyacinth's luxury barbecue, she resorts to desperate musical measures to keep her family scandals from public exposure.

title: People's Palaces: The Golden Age of Civic Architecture
description: Jonathan Foyle visits neo-Gothic Victorian buildings in northern England, as Gothic moved from sacred to secular to become the north's civic style of choice.

title: Scotland: Rome's Final Frontier
description: Archaeologist Dr Fraser Hunter looks back on three centuries of contact and conflict with Scotland's Roman invaders, a story of a superpower pitted against tribesmen and warlords.

title: Treasures of the Anglo Saxons
description: Dr Nina Ramirez reveals the codes and messages hidden in Anglo-Saxon art by examining artefacts like the Sutton Hoo treasures, the Staffordshire hoard and the Franks Casket.

title: Sunday in the Park with Stephen - Omnibus
description: Documentary that follows Stephen Sondheim teaching the creative process behind musicals.

title: Stephen Sondheim's Old Friends
description: Cameron Mackintosh invites many of Stephen Sondheim's old friends to join him in London's West End for a thrilling, joyously staged production featuring an all-star cast.
